render_3dg_asset: render a 3D Gaussian Splatting asset from a PLY file and JSON camera specs using Mitsuba
load_camera_specs: load camera specifications from a JSON file using volprim.cameras.JSONCameraSpecsIO.load
configure_scene: configure a Mitsuba scene with volprim_rf integrator and ellipsoidsmesh primitives from a PLY file
render_with_integrator: render a scene with volprim_rf integrator using configurable spp, max_depth, and kernel type
write_rendered_image: write a rendered Mitsuba image to an EXR file on disk using mi.util.write_bitmap
